exceptions.reason: Fixed Boxwork core zone (153x283 m) contains Goal plus fixed Target 2 and Target 3 coordinates from level01.json

elements.name: Boxwork campaign begins (Phase 1)
elements.placementRule: Existing Level 1 waypoint matched to Curiosity traverse near early layered mudstone transition

whatIsIt.text: Stratigraphic contact marking the onset of polygonal ridge patterns observed from orbit. Ground imagery along this transition helps constrain how mineral-filled fractures formed in ancient lakebed mudstones.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: major orbital investigation waypoint planned for future Explore driving checks.

elements.name: Top of the ridge, start of the main boxwork region
elements.placementRule: Existing Level 1 waypoint anchored on the ridge overlooking the core boxwork exposure

whatIsIt.text: Elevated ridge crest overlooking intersecting mineral veins that stand proud above wind-eroded troughs. Sampling views from this margin document structural geometry and elevation trends.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: ridge overlook observation stop in future Explore progression.

elements.name: Drill site: Nevado Sajama drill
elements.placementRule: Existing Level 1 drill target inside southern section of the boxwork core zone

whatIsIt.text: Rotary percussive bedrock sampling location targeting cemented sedimentary ridges for powder analysis. Drilled core mineralogy helps identify how groundwater chemistry evolved over Martian geologic history.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: multi-sol core sampling stop consuming energy and time in future Explore mode.

elements.name: Boxwork ridge network
elements.placementRule: Maximum-spacing corner inside coreZoneBounds (>=100 m from goal, maximizing clearance from fixed targets)

whatIsIt.text: Raised lattice of mineral-hardened fracture fills left standing after softer host mudstone weathered away under desert winds. Analog structures on Earth indicate prolonged subsurface fluid flow through fractured sediments.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: primary science-campaign survey feature inside the final destination zone.

elements.name: Soft sand pocket
elements.placementRule: DEM concave hollow (TPI < -4 m, slope < 12 deg, lower apron)

whatIsIt.text: Windblown basaltic silt and loose ripple sand trapped inside gentle topographic hollows. Dark unconsolidated sand can sink rover wheels and stall traction without careful slip monitoring.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: increases slip risk and drive duration in future simulation.

elements.name: Rockfall zone
elements.placementRule: DEM steep escarpment strictly above 25 deg slope in slope_5m.bin

whatIsIt.text: Steep fractured bedrock cliffs shedding angular boulders onto apron talus slopes below. Unstable blocky scree creates high roll hazards and hazardous wheel punctures along steep scarps.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: adds severe structural hazard near steep cliff overhangs.

elements.name: Dust devil corridor
elements.placementRule: Flat open pediment sector (slope < 10 deg) along northern eastern corridor

whatIsIt.text: Convective daytime vortex lifting bright fine dust across warm open crater plains. Passing vortices loft charged dust grains that can coat camera lenses and optics briefly.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: temporary visibility and dust-accumulation hazard along flat corridors.

elements.name: Radio shadow
elements.placementRule: Terrain cell line-of-sight occluded behind DEM ridge from simulated SE orbiter direction

whatIsIt.text: Topographic trough where flanking bedrock ridges block grazing direct line-of-sight to passing orbiter relays. Steep crater walls interrupt UHF communications windows until the rover drives clear.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: interrupts orbiter uplink telemetry checks in future Explore simulation.

elements.name: Radiation shelter
elements.placementRule: DEM Sky-View Factor sheltered pocket (SVF < 0.85 matching Radiation lens)

whatIsIt.text: Recessed bedrock alcove beneath steep surrounding walls that narrows open sky hemisphere above the rover. Natural cliff shielding lowers cosmic ray exposure relative to flat exposed plains.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: reduces simulated cumulative cosmic radiation dose while resting here.

elements.name: Oxygen cache
elements.placementRule: Staged supply cache placed on moderate accessible bench near central corridor

whatIsIt.text: Pressurized reserve canister depot planted along planning waypoints to support hypothetical crewed or long-endurance operations. Supply caches offer safety margins far from base.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: replenishes reserve life-support / consumables buffer in future game modes.

elements.name: Battery / solar ridge
elements.placementRule: Elevated sunlit DEM ridge crest (TPI > 5 m, high solar incidence, navigable slope < 18 deg)

whatIsIt.text: Sunlit topographic crest rising above local shadows to catch broad overhead illumination across the sol. Ridge crests maximize solar charging potential for solar-powered surface assets.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: boosts simulated solar battery recovery in future Explore simulation.

elements.name: Comm relay beacon
elements.placementRule: Exposed clear-sky DEM crest (SVF > 0.91, TPI > 5 m) along eastern spur

whatIsIt.text: Deployed autonomous transceiver sited on open high ground with nearly unobstructed sky visibility. Elevated beacons extend surface telemetry coverage across adjacent terrain shadows.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: strengthens simulated orbiter comm margin along nearby sectors.

elements.name: Layered rock outcrop
elements.placementRule: Exposed moderate-slope bench (15 to 24 deg slope) cutting across stratigraphy

whatIsIt.text: Laminated sedimentary beds exposed where wind abrasion has stripped away loose regolith cover. Fine horizontal rock strata preserve seasonal or deltaic depositional cycles inside Gale Crater.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: yields passive geologic stratigraphy science bonus on pass.

elements.name: Clay-rich sample patch
elements.placementRule: Selected inside CRISM MRDR t0902 phyllosilicate spectral cluster on gentle ground

whatIsIt.text: Fine-grained lacustrine mudstone holding clay mineral absorption bands visible from orbital spectrometers. Clay minerals record neutral-water alteration environments capable of preserving organics.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: high-value orbital mineral ground-truthing stop.

elements.name: Mineral vein hint
elements.placementRule: Selected inside CRISM MRDR t0902 strong hydrated sulfate/H2O cluster

whatIsIt.text: Light-toned mineral fracture fills formed when calcium-sulfate brines precipitated inside buried rock cracks. Orbitally mapped hydrated bands guide rovers toward water-bearing mineralization.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: awards spectral follow-up science points when inspected.

elements.name: Concretion field
elements.placementRule: Gentle bedrock apron along mid-eastern traverse corridor

whatIsIt.text: Weathering-resistant diagenetic nodules cemented by groundwater fluids after sediment burial. Eroded pea-sized nodules accumulate as lag gravels across wind-scoured benches.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: yields sedimentary diagenesis observation points.

elements.name: Possible iron meteorite
elements.placementRule: Dark dense anomaly flagged near western sandy corridor for Explore reveal

whatIsIt.text: High-reflectance pitted metallic boulder contrasting strongly against powdery iron-oxide crater soil. Heavy iron-nickel fragments survive thin atmospheric entry and linger unburied on rocky surfaces.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: unlocks rare planetary anomaly scan bonus once inspected in Explore.

elements.name: Anomalous radar reflector
elements.placementRule: Unidentified sub-surface echo located off main corridor for Explore reveal

whatIsIt.text: Strong localized backscatter signature beneath wind-sorted mantle suggestive of dense blocky talus or buried fracture breccia. Only close surface reconnaissance resolves whether texture or bedrock composition drives the echo.

elements.effectOnMission: Placeholder: hidden secondary scan anomaly revealed in Explore mode.
